chunks: Yunus ibn Yaqoub narrated from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who publicized our hadith did not kill us with an erroneous killing, but he killed us with a deliberate killing.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'killing' the Imams through publicizing their hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between accidental harm and deliberate destruction of the Imams' authority, asserting that the careless publicization of their traditions by those who lack deep understanding constitutes a willful act of 'killing' their spiritual influence. This highlights the Shia scholarly principle that *al-jahlu bi-l-hadith* (ignorance of the hadith) is not merely an error but a culpable negligence that erodes the community's grasp of divine guidance.

en.hubeali:
Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who publicised our<sup>asws</sup> Ahadeeth did not kill us an erroneous killing, but he killed us<sup>asws</sup> a deliberate killing’.
en.sarwar: 4. Yunus ibn Ya’qub has narrated from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Whoever publicizes our (confidential) Hadith is like one who does not kill us by mistake but he does so on purpose.’”
